en.v: By the age of ten, the little girl had
her first collection of poems. She’s now very famous.

examples.zh: 这个小女孩在 10 岁的时候已经出版了她的第一本诗集。她现在很出名。

errata.original: By the age of ten, the little girl had published her first collection of poems.（下划线在 had 上）
errata.corrected: By the age of ten, the little girl had published her first collection of poems.（下划线在 published 上）
errata.note: 例句下划线应标在词目形式 published 上，原书误标在 had 上；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 91 条）确认更正
